# Review, pass 1 — secret-history-230-236 (§§230–236)

Reviewer checked every note's grammatical labels against the forms, original to `l` word by word, `l` against `i`, remembered English in `i`, house renderings (conventions.md), and every morph lemma and gloss against the Ming gloss in packet.md and against the existing glossary. `t` and all word counts are untouched (checked by script: same `t` per unit, same number of `words` per unit, first-morph bracket equals the packet Ming gloss for all 513 words). Edits were made in place in units.json by script; the file is valid JSON in the original layout.

Units are numbered U0–U69 in order (U0 = Čiṅgis Qaγan ügülerün, §230; U69 = neken čaγ̇uražu …, §236). Word indices are the packet indices.

Totals: critical 0, major 2, moderate 12, minor 20 (34 changes).

## Changes

### Major
1. U3 + U4 · `l`, `i`, `n` · major · ölžeten (idx 30) is the last word of U3, but U3's note said it "opens the next unit", U3's `l` and `i` left it out altogether, and U4's `l` and `i` supplied "Fortunate" for it, so a word was missing from one unit and present in the other. Done: U3 `l` ends "fortune-having-ones"; U3 `i` ends "— the fortunate ones —" (the cut falls between the adjective and its noun, said in the note); U4 `l`/`i` lose "Fortunate"; both notes rewritten.
2. U19 · `l`, `i`, `n`, morph 162 · major · `i` turned the converb keġežü into an imperative ("call them …") followed by a question, put "blessings" for nendüġüd and "fortune" for qutuγ (the reverse of §207, nendü qutuγ = "fortune and blessing"), and the note called the stem of nendüġüd "unclear" though the glossary has nendü. Done: `i` "calling them my good fortunes and my blessing: should it not be so?"; `l` gains "(acc.)" on kešigten-i; morph split nendü + -ġüd (plural, uncertain); note rewritten, keeps the question reading as probable and names the other reading (negative wish).

### Moderate
3. Words 30 and 99 (ölžeten, U3 and U11) · morph lemma · moderate · lemma ölžei, "inferred", but the glossary already has ölže (吉慶, "good fortune, blessing") and ölžetü. Done: lemma ölže.
4. U1 · `n`, morph 8 · moderate · eġere- "to encircle" was said to have no parallel; the glossary has eġere- "to attack" (Ming 攻, in eġerekün). Done: lemma kept, gloss and note now tie it to that stem ("besiege, encircle" as the bridge to Ming 圍, marked a guess).
5. U8 · `n` · moderate · itegelten was counted among "three participles"; it is a noun with the possessive -ten. Done: "two participles and a possessive noun".
6. U8 · `i`, `n`, morph 66 · moderate · `i` split "amid the turmoil, among enemies" although iburun büküi daisun has the same shape as the weather line (šilžirin büküi boroγ̇on-a, rendered attributively). Done: `i` "among enemies in turmoil"; note says so. irgetei: note and morph now record that the glossary's irge ("people", Ming 百姓) does not match the Ming 地𢫯, so it stays unrendered.
7. U11 · `i`, `n`, morphs 104/112 · moderate · `i` joined the two names with "and" (the Mongol has none); the note claimed the allocation of names to groups was unmarked without saying why; keġegdün could be mistaken for the passive keġegdekün (Ming 被說每). Done: `i` "Call them my fortunate night guard, the elder night guard."; note explains that, unlike U12–14, no accusative marks a group, so the preceding description is the group (other reading not excluded), and separates keġegdün from keġegdekün; morph gloss "a variant of -dkün (uncertain)".
8. U14, U54 · `i`, `n`, morphs 119/391 · moderate · Bugidai/Bukidai written Bukidai in `i`, but 不吉歹 at idx 119 is the same Han as Bügidei in §225 (house name, 224–226), and 不乞歹 at idx 391 stands beside the same Jesün-Te'e. Done: `i` Bügidei in both; lemma Bügidei (the glossary's) in both; `l` keeps Shiratori's spelling; notes say so.
9. U17 · `n` · moderate · called "a dative pair"; köġüd (Ming 子每, no 行) has no case ending, only uruγ-a has -a. Done: note rewritten; `i` keeps "to … and to …" as an address and says so.
10. U49 · `i`, `n` · moderate · `i` dropped the second žarγu and the ablative: "Let the night guard hear cases together with Shigi-Qutuqu". Done: "Let judges from the night guard hear cases together with Shigi-Qutuqu", first žarγu = the cases, second = the judges; note says so.
11. U50 (note) + U52 (`i`, `n`, morph 382) · moderate · the same construction Kebteġül-eče … tügeġeldütügei was rendered with the ablative as "From the night guard" in U50 and as the night guard being the agent in U52; the Ming 敎 before 共 was unexplained. Done: U52 `i` "From the night guard, together with the cherbi, let the bolts of cloth be shared out"; U50 note records both readings of -eče (Ming 宿衞處) and that 敎 is unaccounted; U52 čerbin's -n now labelled "plural or stem-n (uncertain)" as in U21/U39.
12. U66 · `n` · moderate · speaker of "Ese bulγaba": the note's reasoning ("keġen belongs to the Qahan's next act") was opaque. Done: note argues from converb subject-sharing (keġen, sojurγažu share the subject of bolba, the Qahan) and names the alternative (Qubilai, as he presents Arslan). `i` kept.
13. U68 · `i`, `n`, morph 498 · moderate · teregetü analysed as a phantom stem tereg + -etü; the glossary (§199 teregetü-ji) has terege + -tü. `i` also put "against" before the sons, which the Mongol does not have there (and U69 then said "pursued them"). Done: terege + -tü; `i` "the sons of Toqto'a of the Merkid — …"; note says in-ü repeats Toqto'a and that the unit has no verb.
14. U69 · `i` · moderate · neken čaγ̇uražu was reduced to "pursued them" (čaγ̇ura- "go out on campaign" lost). Done: "went out on campaign in pursuit of them, overtook them at the river Chu, wiped them out, and came."; note "to" → "at" the river.

## Findings refused (and why)

- eġületei / örügetei: -tei "having" (Ming 有的) is correct; `l` and `i` follow. Kept.
- eġeren, irgetei: left uncertain; no further evidence (see 4, 6).
- ubis / hubis: only the Ming 但動 supports "at the slightest"; note already says so; the spelling difference is recorded. Kept.
- keġedkün: not split into -d + -kün; the glossary treats -dkün as one ending (ügüledkün, idedkün, sedkidkün). Kept.
- žida: Ming 搶 read as a slip for 槍; honest and marked uncertain in note and morph. Kept.
- ödgen, tüsürge, aγ̇urasu, oγ̇ošin, aγtas-ača asaražu oγ̇ošin ačižu: no better reading in the Ming; the notes say "Doubtful"; kept (`i` for ödgen given a "(?)").
- nutuγ̇učiṅ, eġüdečin: single morph with the agent -či + -n spelled out in the gloss, as for aduγ̇učin, qoničin, temeġečin. Kept.
- bidan-u beje čerig (U36): "our own army" is only one of the readings and the note says it is doubtful; no Ming support for another. Kept.
- U46–47 (Tein dabqur qaγas qaγas jabudaltan): left literal; no reading is supported; the note says it is not understood. Not guessed at.
- šilžirin, silgüdgen, čidγun: unanalysed, noted as such. Kept.
- Ögöle (斡歌列, as in §191's Ögöle-Cherbi): kept; but §225–226 (house, 224–226) has Ögere (斡格舌列) for the same company ("day guards who entered with Ögere the cherbi"). Left for the owner (see below).
- "chaff" (qoγ, Ming 碎草), "cups" (ajaγa, Ming 器), "guardsman" for kešigten: acceptable renderings of the Ming; kept.
- U1 `i` "On cloudy nights … they let me sleep": the subject arrives in U2 and the note says so. Kept.
- Quote marks: checked against Shiratori's marks in the notes (opening supplied in `i` only at U26, U27, U33, U52; U46/U47 inner marks mine). All consistent. Kept.

## New house renderings to record

- Bügidei for Bugidai (不吉歹) and Bukidai (不乞歹), lemma Bügidei, as in §225.
- ölže (not ölžei) is the lemma of ölžeten ("fortune-having, fortunate"); nendü qutuγ → "good fortune(s) and blessing", as in §207.
- terege + -tü (not tereg + -etü), "of the iron cart".
- keġe- naming: X-i NAME keġegdün / keġedkün → "call them NAME"; keġegdün (Ming 說您) is a variant of -dkün, not the passive of keġegdekün.
- jabudal, baidal: -dal verbal noun; -tan plural possessive.
- kebteġül- + lü: the printer's hyphen; lü = particle "only" (cf. bidan-lu).
- nutuγ̇učin → "camp-manager(s)"; kebteġül-eče before a verb of sharing/gathering → "from the night guard", without choosing who gives.
- uqažu atuγai (Ming 省着) → "be mindful of".
- Open for the owner: the name Ögöle / Ögere / Ögele / Ögölei (cherbi) across §§124, 191, 226, 230, 234.
